title: Embedded Dental, Vision, Hearing and Everyday Benefit Allowances of the Ridgecrest Advantage Plans
content:
Each Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan carries its own embedded supplemental benefit allowances for the plan year, and its own figures for the fitness membership, the covered transportation trips and the meals covered after an inpatient discharge.

| Plan | Comprehensive dental allowance for the plan year (USD) | Eyewear allowance for the plan year (USD) | Hearing aid allowance per ear per plan year (USD) | Over-the-counter and healthy-food allowance loaded each calendar quarter (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 500 | 150 | 500 | 45 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 1000 | 250 | 750 | 90 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 1500 | 350 | 1000 | 135 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 1000 | 250 | 750 | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 2000 | 400 | 1250 | 175 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 3000 | 600 | 1750 | 250 |

| Plan | Network fitness membership included | Plan-covered one-way non-emergency transportation trips per plan year | Home-delivered meals covered after an inpatient discharge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | no | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | yes | 24 | 14 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | yes | 36 | 28 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | yes | 12 | 14 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | yes | 48 | 28 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | yes | 60 | 56 |

The hearing aid figure is an allowance per ear for the plan year, so a member fitted in both ears has that figure available for each. The over-the-counter and healthy-food figure is loaded each calendar quarter, not once for the year.

Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) is the one plan carrying no fitness membership, no covered transportation trips and no covered meals after discharge, its figures being 0 trips and 0 meals. Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) carries the largest figure in every column of this schedule.
